title: The Polynomial Hirsch Conjecture
exact_target: Can every pair of vertices of any bounded polytope be joined by an edge path whose length is bounded by one fixed polynomial in its dimension and number of facets?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 44 (CS-002). CC BY 4.0.
